problem_text:
An international art curator must arrange a tour for a rare collection across 11 major museums:
Museum Alpha: Positioned at (35,40)
Museum Beta: Positioned at (31,178)
Museum Gamma: Positioned at (30,97)

Museum Iota: Positioned at (190,106)
Museum Kappa: Positioned at (55,122)
Museum Lambda: Positioned at (125,177)

Due to diplomatic protocols, no direct transport corridor exists between Museum Alpha and Museum Beta.
Furthermore, the tour's logistical plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two special transit segments: the corridor between Museum Beta and Museum Gamma, or the corridor between Museum Gamma and Museum Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that visits each museum exactly once, concluding the exhibition at the initial venue.
